articles.summary: Interest-only $150M Oaktree facility repays Aquestive’s $45M loan and cuts near-term principal, with more funding on FDA approval and sales milestones.
articles.title: Aquestive Therapeutics Completes $150 Million Debt Refinancing with Oaktree

articles.summary: After-market Q1 results arrive May 13, with recent business updates. Management hosts an 8 a.m. ET webcast May 14; replay stays online 30 days.
articles.title: Aquestive Therapeutics to Report First Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Recent Business Highlights on May 13 and Host Conference Call on May 14 at 8:00 a.m. ET

articles.summary: Refinancing saves $45M in principal and defers payments to 2031, while Q1 net loss narrows to $8.1M and Anaphylm NDA resubmission stays on Q3 2026 track.
articles.title: Aquestive Therapeutics Reports First Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Business Update
